Description
UCD is ranked among the best universities in the world and is the most popular choice for international students studying in Ireland. Founded in 1854, UCD is one of the country’s oldest universities. It's also its largest, offering a diverse range of degree programs. The UCD College of Business is Ireland’s top business school. It's one of only 102 schools in the world to hold triple accreditation from AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA (MBA Today, 2020). Studying at the International Study Centre will develop the English language and academic skills students need to succeed in an undergraduate degree at University College Dublin. The the International Foundation Year has a choice of two subject routes - Engineering and Sciences or Business, Economics, and Social Sciences.
